400 Bad Request error when OCR input has an invalid image format

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.literllm.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var requestJson = "{\"document\":{\"type\":\"document_url\",\"url\":\"invalid://url\"},\"model\":\"mistral/mistral-ocr-latest\"}";
        var request = JsonUtil.fromJson(requestJson, OcrRequest.class);
        var apiKey = System.getenv("API_KEY");
        if (apiKey == null || apiKey.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalStateException("API_KEY must be set");
        try (var client = LiterLlm.createClient(apiKey, null, null, null, null)) {
        var result = client.ocr(request);
        System.out.println(result);
        }
        catch (LiterLlmException error) {
            System.err.println(error.getClass().getSimpleName() + ": " + error.getMessage());
        }
    }
}
```
